recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core source follow-up is needed unless future generated output shows that active Bundle, Binary, or CompartmentDefinition example lists fail to render.
issue_request: FHIR-2974 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core FHIR-I change request from the Initial Draft/DSTU1 era asking for an Examples tab on the old 'Tags, Bundles, Compartments and Binary Resources' extras section so implementers could find XML and JSON examples.
initial_application: Jira comments say to add references to existing examples and cite svn revisions 3083 and 3084. Converted git commits 2f90dba297ecb405b31de9bc7a6cd673872dd448 and 08db2f4f096142be620f434ef423284ef7f22aa5 wired an Examples child into the old extras page hierarchy and added source/extras-examples.html with tag/taglist, Bundle, and Binary example references.
additional_context: The current build no longer has source/extras.html, extras-examples.html, or the FHIR-core-extras tab structure. Bundle, Binary, and CompartmentDefinition are active resources in source/fhir.ini and have current list-*-examples.xml files. Tags are now represented through Resource.meta.tag and _tag search; old TagList/taglist examples are obsolete after later replacement of atom/taglist wrappers with native Bundle/resource metadata. Existing combined-branch audits already cover FHIR-2976 and FHIR-5667.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because current active resources already expose examples, the old extras page is gone, and restoring an Examples tab or TagList examples would reintroduce retired material.
